items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: The same Jack Tiboo got me with Paul Ash on the [Publix] Circuit

ctx.x: And I really always wanted to write, all those early years, when I was -- when I later became a single in vaudeville, I made a-- quite a bit of money doing a single. The same Jack Tiboo got me with Paul Ash on the [Publix] Circuit and I was working a single, I was maybe 18-19 years old. 19 I guess. Maybe before I was 20 -- I know the years I'm not sure --
